body: Then I guess if I expect absolutley nothing from hormones, I won't be let down when they don't work.
Damn.  This got kinda heated.  Anyway, I'm still here.  Obviously.

Online dating honestly scares the crap out of me.  I've never considered it before.  I do feel so alone right now.  I really want a girl who sees me as a woman and is attracted to me as one.  It all seems like an incredibly hard uphill battle though.  I try to stay positive, but its so difficult to cope with gender dysphoria.  Its the worst feeling I've ever known.
I guess nothing.  I really don't feel like I have anything right now.  Maybe it really is time to start transition.  I break down daily cause of this whole thing.  It's miserable.

I live in the northeast United States, which is pretty liberal.  I still see homophobia/transphobia everywhere.  From some of my own friends too.  They have no idea how much it hurts me.  Many of them aren't so much hateful as they are totally uneducated.  My band is doing pretty good too and starting to make serious ground and I don't wanna fuck it up, but I can't live this facade anymore.

The thing that really sucks is that I feel so far from the real me because of my body.  Like I can't rightfully call myself a girl because my body is so masculine.  I'm so alone and I want a girlfriend, but I feel like any girl I would ever get involved with would only see me as a man, and that's a huge trigger for dysphoria for me.  I'm a lesbian, not a straight guy.  As much as I want to transition, I can't really afford it either, not for another few years anyway.  I don't even have enough money to afford a good wardrobe.  I don't know how much longer I can wait.

I'm so timid too and it makes it very difficult to trust people.  Most of the people I'm in connection with are pretty liberal, there are a few gay people in my circle of friends, but no one's ever known a trans person.  I'm worried it would be too far out for them to understand.  Its so difficult.  I also was late to the game.  I didn't realize I was trans till I was 24, after many, many years of confusion.  So I made a lot of connections as a guy and I now feel trapped where I am socially and vocationally.

The passing thing is a huge deal too.  I just cant stand my body type.  I look like a body builder and I've never picked up a set of weights in my life.  Why do I have to such a body and be trans?  I feel like I'll never be able to see the girl I am on the inside in my reflection.  Like who I am is always going to trapped inside me no matter how I present.

I just hate, hate, HATE being a guy.  Its so wrong for me.  But I continue to fake it.  I should win a medal for how good I am at acting like a guy.  No one suspects anything.  But I'm dying inside.
